card.name: Section numbers in cross-references
card.fires_on: Digits or the closing parenthesis inside bracketed label cross-references like [see Warnings and Precautions (5.2)], especially the last number before the closing bracket and the period that ends the sentence.

modes.label: Digits in section numbers
modes.description: A number part such as 6, 12 or 3 inside a parenthesized section reference.

modes.label: Closing parenthesis
modes.description: The closing parenthesis of a section reference right before the bracket and sentence period.

card.writes: It favors a sentence-ending period after the bracketed reference and discourages periods followed by markup or line breaks.
card.plain: It marks the numbers inside a [see Section X.Y] pointer, where the sentence is about to end.
